summary.en: Use the most recent unmatched opener to find bracket errors and their positions.
summary.bn: সবশেষে খোলা বন্ধনী মিলিয়ে ভুল বন্ধনীর অবস্থান বের করো।

notes: Programs use C17 with explicit bounds and ownership checks.

examples.title: Track three bracket families
examples.explanationHtml: Every closer matches the most recent opener, so Error: 0 means success.

examples.title: Detect a crossed pair immediately
examples.explanationHtml: Position three contains a round closer while the pending opener is square.

examples.title: Locate an opener left at the end
examples.explanationHtml: The square pair closes, leaving the brace at position two unmatched.

practice.title: Report the first bracket error
practice.statementHtml: Read one line of at most 24 characters. Ignore non-bracket characters. Print the prompt and Error: 0 if balanced; otherwise print the 1-based closer position, or the oldest remaining opener position at end.
hints: Store a position beside each opener.

practice.title: Print a balance verdict
practice.statementHtml: Read a line of at most 24 characters. With the same input prompt, print Balanced or Unbalanced for (), [] and {} nesting.
hints: An empty line contains no unmatched brackets.

practice.title: Measure maximum bracket nesting
practice.statementHtml: Read a line of at most 24 characters. Print the expression prompt and Invalid for a bracket error. Otherwise print Maximum: depth Pairs: count. Ignore ordinary characters.
hints: Validate bracket families before counting the accepted structure.

practice.title: Count matched pairs by bracket family
practice.statementHtml: Read a line of at most 24 characters. Print the expression prompt and Invalid for a bracket error. Otherwise print Round: count Square: count Brace: count. Ignore non-bracket characters.
hints: After balance is proved, each closer completes exactly one pair of its family.

quiz.prompt: Why does ([)] fail despite equal counts?
options: The closing order crosses the opening order

quiz.prompt: Which pending opener must a right brace match?
options: The top opener, which must be {
quiz.explanation: Skipping an inner opener would accept crossed nesting.

quiz.prompt: What does a closer find in an empty bracket stack?
quiz.explanation: A closing bracket needs a pending partner.

quiz.prompt: Which location is reported for text (( by this policy?
quiz.explanation: The policy selects the oldest remaining opener at end.

quiz.prompt: What does an empty input line mean for bracket balance?
How much space can n consecutive opening brackets require?
quiz.explanation: Every opener remains pending until a closer arrives.

quiz.prompt: Does bracket balance prove valid C syntax?
quiz.explanation: Other syntax and semantic rules need separate checks.

quiz.prompt: How deep is the pending stack after reading (()?
quiz.explanation: Two openings and one closing leave one pending opener.

quiz.prompt: Which position does a zero-based index of four report?
quiz.explanation: Human-readable character positions start at one.

quiz.prompt: Does the pair [ and ) pass the family test?
quiz.explanation: A round closer cannot close a square opener.

keyPoints.en: Nested brackets close in reverse opening order.
Store opener positions to explain unfinished input.
keyPoints.bn: অসম্পূর্ণ expression ধরতে খোলা বন্ধনীর অবস্থান রাখো।

keyPoints.en: A mismatched closer stops the scan immediately.
keyPoints.bn: না মেলা বন্ধ বন্ধনী পেলেই পরীক্ষা থামাও।

keyPoints.en: Non-bracket characters do not change this bracket stack.
keyPoints.bn: বন্ধনী ছাড়া অন্য অক্ষরে এই স্ট্যাক বদলায় না।

keyPoints.en: Scanning n characters needs O(n) time and O(n) worst-case space.
keyPoints.bn: n অক্ষর দেখতে O(n) সময় আর সর্বোচ্চ O(n) জায়গা লাগে।

examQuestions.question: Which position does the stated policy report for [()]{}( and why?
examQuestions.answerHtml: The first six characters form two complete groups. The opener at position seven remains unmatched at the end, so report seven. The earlier groups leave no pending entries.

examQuestions.question: Draw the bottom-to-top stack after each character of {[(])}. Stop at the first error.
examQuestions.answerHtml: After { the stack is [{]. After [ it is [{, []. After ( it is [{, [, (]. At character four, ] expects [ but finds (. Report position four without discarding the opener.

examQuestions.question: Explain why a stack of unmatched openers is sufficient, including end-of-input behavior.
examQuestions.answerHtml: After each accepted prefix, the stack contains exactly its unmatched openers in opening order. An opener extends this sequence. A closer must match its final entry, so a mismatch proves incorrect nesting. At the end, an empty sequence means every opener closed; any remaining entry proves an incomplete expression.
